title: Published service level definition
description: Versioned SLA and SLO document defining availability per capability (read access, submission, approval, payment dispatch), measurement window, exclusions, and how fail-closed refusals are counted.

title: Availability measurement stream
description: Synthetic probes from at least two external vantage points per capability and server-side success ratios per tenant, retained raw so customers can recompute reported figures.
notes: CNV-EXP-001 requires published service levels to be measured with a stated methodology before publication.

title: Monthly availability report per tenant
description: Computed availability per capability and tenant against SLO, with incident references, exclusions applied and credits owed.

title: Status page and notification log
description: Component-level status history hosted independently of production, with time of first customer notice per incident and subscriber delivery records.

title: Incident post-mortem reports
description: Customer-facing root-cause report per qualifying incident with timeline, impact by tenant and capability, and corrective actions.

title: Change calendar and maintenance notices
description: Record of scheduled maintenance notices, actual downtime per change, and change-freeze periods, linked to Praxis change provenance.
producer: Praxis (change provenance) plus not yet assigned notice system

title: Service credit ledger
description: Per-tenant record of SLA misses, credits calculated, claims and payments.

title: Subprocessor dependency and status register
description: Mapping of each capability to the subprocessors it depends on, their published SLAs, live status feed and historical incidents affecting the service.

title: Degraded-mode behavior test results
description: Automated tests showing, for each dependency failure, which functions continue, which fail closed, and what the user interface displays, including payment status Unknown.
